messages:
maria: Heads-up: found a broken JS snippet in the Streaming guide that can cause an infinite loop. I opened a hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :warning:
kevin: Can you share repro and impact?
docs-bot: PR #4921 opened by maria  CI: unit tests passed, lint reported one whitespace rule. Staging build queued (build-2026-03-15-21).
maria: Repro: paste snippet into Node REPL with streaming enabled. Bug is misuse of `for await` on stream; fix in PR swaps to `for await (const chunk of stream.chunks())`.
ashley: That TS snippet in /guides/streaming also had an incorrect comment about autoFlush; I pushed a small patch to the branch to fix types and remove the misleading note.
samir: I'll draft the erratum blurb: "Fix: corrected streaming examples (JS/TS) to prevent infinite loop in Node runtimes; added workaround and notes on buffer handling." Keep it short for the changelog.
leo: Proposed rollout: (1) merge hotfix, (2) canary to staging for 30m at 21:30 UTC, (3) smoke test in Node14/18 containers, (4) prod push and CDN purge flag. I'll run the publish steps.
kevin: Do we need a customer ping or a known-issues entry?
maria: Not widespread but could break new integrations. Add a short erratum entry to v0.9.7 changelog and a 48h banner on the streaming page. Samir, please include a quick workaround for users.
samir: Workaround added: use `stream.readableStreamDefaultReader()` or `stream.chunks()`. I'll drop both in the PR description and the release note.
leo: Rollback plan: `git revert -m 1 <merge_sha>` then `bin/content publish --tag v0.9.7-erratum` rollback via CDN if needed. I'll paste exact commands in ops checklist.
docs-bot: Staging build completed: build-2026-03-15-21  smoke tests: 12/12 passed.
maria: Merging after squash and lint fix. Tagging branch hotfix/docs/streaming-4921.
ashley: Confirmed TS comment removed. :thumbsup:
kevin: Scheduling canary at 21:30 UTC. Support will prep canned response.
leo: Standing by to purge CDN after prod push: `bin/content purge --paths "/guides/streaming*" --async`
maria: Thanks all. After canary and clean smoke, we'll publish and post update in #general with workaround link.
samir: Drafted short erratum blurb into PR and changelog draft; will update with merge sha once merged.
docs-bot: Merge of PR #4921 initiated by maria  awaiting final CI lint fix.
